The confirmed mortality match also overrides other compliance rules, resulting in non-compliance with FCA and AML/KYC regulations. Enhanced Due Diligence: Not required. The combination of these risk signals and compliance findings supports the recommendation to reject the application.
final_recommendations: Reject the application due to the confirmed mortality match and other risk signals
